name: spellkave_session_open
label: Spellkave Session Open
description: Open an interaction session (e.g. dialogue, combat) for bodies the caller directly controls via r_session_open. Seeing a body through a grant does not permit opening for it. Publisher maintenance may set up other participants. Success is provenance-observed.

participants_csv.description: Optional comma-separated participant body ids the caller directly controls. Defaults to empty.
